name: ZC & ZS Carry Quartile Analysis
description: Buckets current carry (cont.carry) into quartiles using percentrank(252) for both corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS). Shows avg forward 63-day carry and hit rate (% times forward carry is positive) by quartile. Forward carry uses the lead operator (carry << 63) to avoid division-by-zero when carry crosses zero. ZC is the primary asset; ZS is loaded via reference_futures + futures_continuation with NoAdjustment.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZC & ZS CARRY QUARTILE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Question: Does the level of carry predict where carry will be in 63 days?
#
# Method:
#   - Bucket current carry into quartiles via percentrank(period=252)
#     (S44: percentrank for equal-population buckets, NOT z-score thresholds)
#   - Forward carry = carry << 63  (S46: lead operator, NOT forward_returns —
#     carry crosses zero so division-by-zero would corrupt results)
#   - Hit rate = 1.0 if fwd_carry > 0 else 0.0  (S41: ternary, NOT where(cond,1.0))
#   - NoAdjustment on both ZC and ZS (carry signal requires real price levels)
# =============================================================================

# --- ZC (Corn): primary asset ---
src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc_carry = zc_cont.carry

# --- ZS (Soybeans): reference asset ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)

zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# =============================================================================
# QUARTILE BUCKETING
# percentrank(252) → 0-100 → map to Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 (equal-population buckets)
# Q1 = deepest contango (lowest carry), Q4 = strongest backwardation (highest carry)
# =============================================================================

zc_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(zc_carry)
zs_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(zs_carry)

# ZC quartile label (1=lowest carry, 4=highest carry)
zc_quartile = conditional_select(
    zc_pctrank <= 25, 1,
    zc_pctrank <= 50, 2,
    zc_pctrank <= 75, 3,
    4
)

# ZS quartile label
zs_quartile = conditional_select(
    zs_pctrank <= 25, 1,
    zs_pctrank <= 50, 2,
    zs_pctrank <= 75, 3,
    4
)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD CARRY (63 trading days ahead)
# Use lead operator << NOT forward_returns() — carry can be ~0 at crossover
# causing division-by-zero and inf values (S46)
# =============================================================================

zc_fwd_carry = zc_carry << 63
zs_fwd_carry = zs_carry << 63

# =============================================================================
# HIT RATE FLAG: 1.0 if forward carry is positive, else 0.0
# Ternary (not where(cond, 1.0)) so Mean gives true frequency (S41)
# Guard with is_valid() since fwd_carry is NaN on last 63 bars (S02)
# =============================================================================

zc_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_carry) and zc_fwd_carry > 0) else 0.0
zs_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_carry) and zs_fwd_carry > 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# PER-QUARTILE FILTERED SERIES (for summary table — ZC only, per-asset reporter)
# where() filters to each quartile's observations; NaN elsewhere
# =============================================================================

# ZC forward carry by quartile
zc_fwd_q1 = where(zc_quartile == 1, zc_fwd_carry)
zc_fwd_q2 = where(zc_quartile == 2, zc_fwd_carry)
zc_fwd_q3 = where(zc_quartile == 3, zc_fwd_carry)
zc_fwd_q4 = where(zc_quartile == 4, zc_fwd_carry)

# ZC hit rate flag by quartile
zc_hit_q1 = where(zc_quartile == 1, zc_hit)
zc_hit_q2 = where(zc_quartile == 2, zc_hit)
zc_hit_q3 = where(zc_quartile == 3, zc_hit)
zc_hit_q4 = where(zc_quartile == 4, zc_hit)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — ZC Carry Quartile Stats
# Rows: N (count), Median Fwd Carry, Hit Rate
# Cols: Q1 (contango) → Q4 (backwardation)
# Standard mode: 12 inputs mapped to 3×4 grid
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZC Carry Quartile Stats (63-Day Forward Carry)',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['N (obs)', 'Median Fwd Carry', 'Hit Rate (fwd > 0)'],
        col_headers=['Q1 (Contango)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4 (Backwardation)'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: N observations per quartile
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, info='Observations in Q1'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, info='Observations in Q2'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, info='Observations in Q3'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, info='Observations in Q4'),
            # Row 1: Median forward carry per quartile
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, info='Median 63d forward carry in Q1'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, info='Median 63d forward carry in Q2'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, info='Median 63d forward carry in Q3'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4, info='Median 63d forward carry in Q4'),
            # Row 2: Hit rate (% times forward carry > 0) per quartile
            # zc_hit is 0.0/1.0 so Mean = frequency; PercentFormat multiplies ×100 (S27)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% times 63d forward carry > 0 in Q1'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% times 63d forward carry > 0 in Q2'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% times 63d forward carry > 0 in Q3'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% times 63d forward carry > 0 in Q4')
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Quartile Analysis',
    order=1
)(zc_fwd_q1, zc_fwd_q2, zc_fwd_q3, zc_fwd_q4,
  zc_fwd_q1, zc_fwd_q2, zc_fwd_q3, zc_fwd_q4,
  zc_hit_q1, zc_hit_q2, zc_hit_q3, zc_hit_q4)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Avg Forward 63d Carry by Quartile — ZC vs ZS side-by-side
# Grouped bar chart: stack = quartile label (x-axis), name = commodity (legend)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Does Carry Predict Future Carry? Avg 63d Forward Carry by Quartile',
    category='Carry Quartile Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward 63d Carry',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    color_by_value=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero (Flat)')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue,  stack='Q1 (Contango)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray,  stack='Q1 (Contango)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue,  stack='Q2'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray,  stack='Q2'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue,  stack='Q3'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray,  stack='Q3'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue,  stack='Q4 (Backwardation)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray,  stack='Q4 (Backwardation)')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(zc_fwd_carry, zs_fwd_carry, zc_fwd_carry, zs_fwd_carry,
          zc_fwd_carry, zs_fwd_carry, zc_fwd_carry, zs_fwd_carry),
  label=(zc_quartile, zs_quartile, zc_quartile, zs_quartile,
         zc_quartile, zs_quartile, zc_quartile, zs_quartile))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Hit Rate by Quartile — ZC vs ZS side-by-side
# Hit rate = % times forward 63d carry is positive
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='How Often Is Carry Positive in 63 Days? Hit Rate by Quartile',
    category='Carry Quartile Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (fwd carry > 0)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue, stack='Q1 (Contango)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray, stack='Q1 (Contango)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue, stack='Q2'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray, stack='Q2'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue, stack='Q3'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray, stack='Q3'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC (Corn)',     color=Color.Blue, stack='Q4 (Backwardation)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS (Soybeans)', color=Color.Gray, stack='Q4 (Backwardation)')
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=(zc_hit, zs_hit, zc_hit, zs_hit,
          zc_hit, zs_hit, zc_hit, zs_hit),
  label=(zc_quartile, zs_quartile, zc_quartile, zs_quartile,
         zc_quartile, zs_quartile, zc_quartile, zs_quartile))
